explication: DSH-IM is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that connects IM bots and an AI Office Connector to a local Harness. The user configures bots and channel behavior in the plugin settings; the host-side channel integrations manage connections and message handling, with Harness sessions producing replies back through the messaging channels. The README also describes multi-bot management and channel-specific features such as voice, streaming, QR setup, and callbacks. Edges are limited to relationships documented in the README or visible in indexed imports; unsampled channel internals are represented at directory level.
